RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the appointed candidate are women, meaning the all-female panel chose between applicants of the same sex. Raising the panel's gender composition provides no evidence of sex discrimination and would undermine your credibility. 

The decision appears based on qualifications: public broadcasters heavily prioritize digital media transformation, which often outweighs traditional newsroom tenure. If any bias were at play, age would be a more plausible concern than sex given the difference in years of experience, but you currently have no evidence of that either.

Do not mention the panel’s composition. Instead, send a polite follow-up request regarding your written feedback, framing it as an effort to identify growth areas for future opportunities.
